subject: Startups
title: How VCs Source Deals
description: Learn How VCs Source Deals in one minute.

hook.text: VCs see thousands of pitches a year but invest in fewer than 1%. Finding the right deals is the hardest part.

buildup.text: The best deals come through warm introductions—a trusted founder or investor vouching for the startup.

discovery.text: Cold emails rarely work. VCs rely on their network because a referral is a signal of quality and trust.

twist.text: Some top VCs now scout proactively—finding founders on Twitter, GitHub, and product launches before they raise.

climax.text: Deal flow is a VC's lifeblood. The firm that sees the best startups first wins the best deals.

punchline.text: In VC, who you know determines what you see.

quiz.question: How do VCs typically find their best investment opportunities?
